social_circle.name: Maria Bonnet

demographics.occupation: part-time home care aide and family homemaker

background.how_they_met: Maria is Jose's mother and raised him in a bilingual Ecuadorian household after immigrating from Ecuador before he was born.
background.why_close: They live together, cook together, shop together, and Maria is the emotional center of Jose's family life.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in Spanish or Spanglish, often short practical messages about errands and food, with affectionate voice notes when something feels important.

shared_activities: talking in the kitchen after dinner
organizing family gatherings and feast-day meals
recent_text_topics: Market Basket lists, what to cook for dinner, and whether they need cilantro, aji, or chicken for seco de pollo.
Family updates about cousins coming by, holiday food plans, and reminders about religious feast days.
Jose's job-search mood and whether he has followed up on applications or community contacts.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 states that Jose lives with his mother Maria in North Attleboro and that she is the emotional center of the family. Q05 also says they cook, shop at Market Basket, watch Spanish news, and talk in the kitchen after dinner.

social_circle.name: Lucia Bonnet

background.how_they_met: Lucia is Jose's younger sister; they grew up in the same Ecuadorian American household in North Attleboro.
background.why_close: They share a home, family responsibilities, bilingual family culture, and a sibling bond that includes both support and arguments about chores and bills.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Fast texter with blunt one-liners, screenshots, reaction emojis, and direct advice. She switches between English and Spanish depending on the mood.

shared_activities: talking through Jose's dating and work decisions
recent_text_topics: Chore reminders, bill timing, and who is picking up household items.
Blunt advice about Jose's job search and whether a role actually fits him.
Teasing Jose about dance nights, soccer plans, and the relationship from last year that did not work out.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Jose lives with his younger sister Lucia, that they are close, and that they argue like siblings about chores and bills. Q07 says Jose calls his sister when he needs someone blunt.

social_circle.name: Marco Rivera

background.how_they_met: Marco and Jose became close through weekend soccer with North Attleboro United.
background.why_close: They share soccer, competitiveness, weekend routines, and enough trust that Jose usually contacts Marco first when something is bothering him.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts casually with sports shorthand, jokes, quick check-ins, and occasional voice notes after games. Uses more humor than sentiment but shows up when needed.

shared_activities: checking in when Jose is stressed
recent_text_topics: Weekend lineup questions, who is bringing gear, and whether Jose's ankle or stamina feels good for the next match.
New England Revolution talk and jokes about missed shots from recent games.
Jose's frustration about being between jobs and whether he should reach out to old community contacts.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says Jose's soccer teammates are a big part of his life, that he plays with North Attleboro United on weekends, and that Marco is one of the close friends. Q07 also says Jose usually calls Marco first when something is bothering him.

social_circle.name: Rosa Andrade

background.how_they_met: Rosa is Jose's aunt in Pawtucket and has been part of his extended family network since childhood.
background.why_close: Jose describes her as almost like a second mother, and they keep up through WhatsApp several times a week.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Mostly WhatsApp in Spanish, with long voice notes, recipe photos, family updates, and requests for help with English wording.

shared_activities: help with forms and English letters
recent_text_topics: Family news from Pawtucket and Providence, especially which cousins are visiting or dealing with errands.
Recipe questions around Ecuadorian dishes and what Jose's mother is cooking.
Help translating English letters, forms, or appointment messages into clearer Spanish.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Jose has an aunt in Pawtucket who is almost like a second mom and that he speaks with her a couple times a week by WhatsApp. Q06 also says she calls about family news, recipes, and help with forms or English letters.

social_circle.name: Carlos Bonnet

background.how_they_met: Carlos is Jose's father and immigrated from Ecuador before Jose was born.
background.why_close: Although Jose's parents are no longer really living as a couple, Carlos lives nearby and Jose sees him weekly or more, often around family dinners or errands.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Brief, practical texts, often about timing, errands, or family dinner plans. More likely to call than write a long message.

shared_activities: listening to boleros and salsa during family cooking
recent_text_topics: Coordinating errands in Attleboro and asking whether Jose can stop by.
Family dinner timing and whether Maria or Lucia will be there.
Checking in on Jose's work plans in a practical, understated way.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Jose's father Carlos lives nearby in Attleboro, that Jose sees him usually once a week or more, and that Jose helps when Carlos needs an errand. Q01 recalls Carlos playing old boleros or salsa during Sunday cooking.
